bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives him a birth date of 24 Mar 1895 at Plymouth and a death date of 30 Jan 1961. It records a WWI draft registration at Wilkes-Barre and service ending on 30 Apr 1919, and his marriage on 10 Oct 1921 in Blackford Co., Indiana, to Maria Verena Alles (1895-1980). In 1940 he was in the household of Mary Alles (S1). The site says he married in New York City in 1915, but FamilySearch has that NYC marriage for his sister Genevieve.
